name: prometheus.exporter.cadvisor

arguments.name: allowlisted_container_labels
arguments.description: Allowlist of container labels to convert to Prometheus labels.

arguments.name: disabled_metrics
arguments.description: List of metrics to be disabled which, if set, overrides the default disabled metrics.

arguments.name: docker_only
arguments.description: Only report docker containers in addition to root stats.

arguments.name: docker_tls_ca
arguments.description: Path to a trusted CA for TLS connection to docker.

arguments.name: docker_tls_cert
arguments.description: Path to client certificate for TLS connection to docker.

arguments.name: docker_tls_key
arguments.description: Path to private key for TLS connection to docker.

arguments.name: enabled_metrics
arguments.description: List of metrics to be enabled which, if set, overrides disabled_metrics.

arguments.name: env_metadata_allowlist
arguments.description: Allowlist of environment variable keys matched with a specified prefix that needs to be collected for containers.

arguments.name: perf_events_config
arguments.description: Path to a JSON file containing the configuration of perf events to measure.

arguments.name: raw_cgroup_prefix_allowlist
arguments.description: List of cgroup path prefixes that need to be collected, even when docker_only is specified.

arguments.name: resctrl_interval
arguments.description: Interval to update resctrl mon groups.

arguments.name: storage_duration
arguments.description: Length of time to keep data stored in memory.

arguments.name: store_container_labels
arguments.description: Whether to convert container labels and environment variables into labels on Prometheus metrics for each container.

arguments.name: use_docker_tls
arguments.description: Use TLS to connect to docker.

exported_fields.name: targets
exported_fields.description: The targets that can be used to collect exporter metrics.
